scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@deep-zoom/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@deep-zoom/api && npm run build --workspace=@deep-zoom/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@deep-zoom/api && npm run lint --workspace=@deep-zoom/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@deep-zoom/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@deep-zoom/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@deep-zoom/api && npm run test --workspace=@deep-zoom/web
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
